Intent

What would you be happy if this became?

You do not have to choose between casual dating and matrimony before you meet anyone. Just say what you are genuinely open to right now.

Your answer, in plain language

Choose the honest starting point.

There is no better answer. Intent simply gives every introduction a little more context from the start.

01Explore

Open to meeting someone.

You want to meet people and see what develops. Introductions and gatherings should respect that pace, not push you toward a label you did not choose.

02Relationship

Looking for a relationship.

You want something meaningful if the connection is right. Pace, intent, and context stay clear, so you are not read as someone looking for something entirely different.

03Life partner

Ready for a life partner.

Long-term partnership is a real goal, without turning your profile into a biodata form. You can say so clearly and meet people who are open to the same horizon.

Nothing is fixed

Life changes. Your intent can too.

You can update what you are open to as your circumstances change. It simply changes the context for future introductions — not the story you have already lived.
